purpose: CLI runtime toolchain for NDJSON stream routing, vault lifecycle operations, and deterministic markdown file-writing workflows for AutoScribe integrations.

public_python_api.contract: Document is the sole public markdown object model.

dispatcher.pattern: static command registry + dynamic module loading

domains.name: sentinel_scan
domains.responsibility: sentinel-based markdown file selection for downstream ingest

domains.name: write
domains.responsibility: batch record persistence with sentinel-aware overwrite safety

domains.name: vault
domains.responsibility: vault provisioning, import, and template application

root_commands.writenew: Write AutoScribe batch records to new files.
root_commands.writeback: Write records back with strict path/slug/sentinel invariants and reroute to new-file behavior when sentinel is absent.
root_commands.writestream: Validate and passthrough single-document markdown streams.
root_commands.scan-sentinel: Select markdown paths whose first line contains a valid ASC batch sentinel.
root_commands.create-project: Alias of create-vault for project vocabulary.
root_commands.import-project: Import draft vault content into a target vault project scaffold.

markdown_contract.rule: Workbench modules should not implement independent frontmatter/YAML parsing paths outside Document.

sentinel_contract.read_behavior: read_batch_sentinel(path) returns slug when first non-empty line is valid sentinel, otherwise null
sentinel_contract.writeback_semantics: missing sentinel means file is treated as not yet batched and writeback creates a new output file instead of overwriting
